fields.value: 25 MPa compressive shear, the low end of 25-30 MPa, Cusil-ABA on monolithic SiC/Mo and SiC/Kovar. Singh and Asthana, J. Materials Engineering and Performance, 2020, doi 10.1007/s11665-020-04934-3.
fields.issue: The shear pair is a lab result. At 562.2 kN the socket is the tube wall continued for 28.9 mm, 0.062 kg per end and 130.6 kg, 0.58 times the allowance. Frozen least SF is 1.232. A solid node is not sized. A co-sintered frame is a PROJECTION. The 342 MPa bend result failed in the ceramic and is not a shear allowable.
fields.consequence: This is the lightest metallic path, and it is not a catalog node.
fields.next: A shear measurement on the tube diameter, and a socket section if the wall cannot simply continue.
